instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot. In an indoor ballet studio with large windows and a wooden barre, the young girl in a blue and white tutu (R1) stands on the left, holding the instructor's hand overhead while extending her other arm and looking up. The blonde ballet instructor in a black leotard and skirt (R2) stands on the right on pointe shoes, holding the girl's hand and smiling as they pose together. Bright natural light streams from the background windows, illuminating the dancers.
